entry.rule: First qualifying minute-close up-cross from below 78 cents to at least 78 cents.
entry.unproven_first: A first valid close already at or above 78 cents, with no earlier valid close below 78 cents, is not a qualifying entry.

stop.rule: A strictly later qualifying minute close at or below 67 cents.
stop.intrabar_low: A low at or below 67 cents inside the entry bar is INTRABAR_AMBIGUITY. It is not the stop.

allocation.resize: After every tenth fully completed trade. Open quantities do not resize.
